model.schedule: ASAP on the record's durations; rz and barrier cost 0; delay = duration x dt
model.idle_budget: per idle window w on qubit q: (1 - e^{-w/T1})/4 + (1 - e^{-w/T2})/2 (Pauli-twirling approximation of thermal relaxation)
model.dd: PadDynamicalDecoupling pads a window when w / (4 x sx_duration) > 2.0 (sequence_min_length_ratios default); one XY4 sequence per window at a cost of 4 x sx_error
model.f: f_gates = prod(1 - cz_error) x prod(1 - measure_error) = gate_S2D.analyse_on_backend on this record; f_gates_only divides the measure survival out
model.yield: y = 0.82 f + (1 - f) a (manual Step 4.4, skqd.skqd.yield_model)
model.rho: the fraction of the DD-eligible T2 budget that survives DD; not computable here

H_A.hypothesis: idle-time relaxation (DD off, J1): f = f_gates e^{-S_T1 - S_T2}

H_B.hypothesis: the SamplerV2 options (DD XY4, twirling active-accum) caused the canary shortfall: with them off the gate-only prediction holds

session_prediction.decision_rule: N1 = accepted shots of the canary pub of J1: N1 <= 100 rejects H_B, N1 >= 250 confirms H_B, 100 < N1 < 250 is inconclusive (prompts/19 D5 C3)
